description: Bug report writer — Turn a messy bug complaint, chat message, log or stack trace (text=, up to 15,000 chars) into a clean, actionable bug report: specific title, summary, steps to reproduce (never invented), expected vs actual, severity (critical/major/minor/trivial) with reason, priority P0-P3, component guess, labels, workaround, likely cause (marked as a guess), user impact and questions to ask the reporter. Offline extraction adds environment (OS, browser, device, app version), error types, fatal signals, HTTP status codes, top stack frames, timestamps, request/trace ids and URLs, a completeness score with gaps, duplicate-search terms and a ready-to-paste GitHub/Jira Markdown issue. Optional: product= name for context. Llama 3.3 70B on Workers AI. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
